asr.full_text: The action of the 27th of November 2017 The BNP action is trying to maintain itself above the general support, going through the lowest of June and September. We can talk about a return of a high momentum as long as the title up under 68 euros. An incursion in the lower levels in November can lead to a correction extension under 60 euros in 2014 and 2015. Join us again at 11 PM for Market Live and tomorrow for other analysis.
